config_text:
# Retrained Perov-5 model for the grounded-generation study (2026-10-06).
# control  = same settings as grounded but WITHOUT the structure-only losses (isolates their effect)
# grounded = adds structure_reconstruction + structure_property (property and structure from z_c alone)
name: perov5_desc_full_s1
description: "desc_full_s1: descriptor-based elements (cgcnn), site-ordered, periodic encoder"
output_dir: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_fix/runs/desc_full_s1/out
data:
  table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_matter_fidelity_check/data/train.csv
  val_table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_matter_fidelity_check/data/val.csv
  id_column: material_id
  cif_column: cif
  properties:
    - {column: heat_all, label: Formation enthalpy, unit: eV/atom, normalize: true}
    - {column: dir_gap,  label: Direct band gap,    unit: eV,      normalize: true}
  max_sites: 5
  site_order: perovskite      # A site, B site, anions (from the Perov-5 formula string)
  align_to_prototype: false
model:
  decoder_coordinate_input: zeros
  periodic_encoder: true
  element_features: cgcnn
training:
  epochs: 200           # same number of epochs as the published model
  batch_size: 64
  learning_rate: 0.001
  seed: 1
  device: cpu
  save_every: 50
  loss_weights: {structure_reconstruction: 1.0, structure_property: 1.0}
